scope: Final Stage-2 project-page identity and PRL000288 were preserved; the linked official archive was retrieved and unpacked only for static source inspection, yielding one explicit Office benchmark workflow and eight configuration records.

unresolved_findings.finding: The external Office benchmark payload was not downloaded or inspected, so asset integrity and end-to-end data availability remain unverified.
The archive documents MATLAB R2009b on Linux but has no dependency manifest or native-extension build instructions; current portability of the bundled MEX artifacts is unknown.
The five-run workflow performs sample selection without an explicit random seed in the inspected entrypoint or configuration files.
The README supplies one illustrative accuracy table, but configuration-specific expected results are not documented for all eight extracted configurations.

notes: The survey's ARC-t scope is kept distinct from the archive's ECCV 2010 implementation description.
No scientific software, dataset, test or benchmark was executed.
